title: Eigen-Agent: Adaptive Multi-Agent Scientific Reasoning with Monitor-Based RAG
abstract: arXiv:2509.21193v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong progress on scientific reasoning, yet two major bottlenecks remain. First, explicit retrieval fragments reasoning, imposing a hidden "tool tax" of extra tokens and steps. Second, multi-agent pipelines often dilute strong solutions by averaging across all candidates. We address these challenges with a unified framework that combines implicit retrieval and structured collaboration. At its foundation, a Monitor-based retrieval module operates at the token level, integrating external knowledge with minimal disruption to reasoning. On top of this substrate, Hierarchical Solution Refinement (HSR) iteratively designates each candidate as an anchor to be repaired by its peers, while Quality-Aware Iterative Reasoning (QAIR) adapts refinement to solution quality. translated_title: Eigen智能体：基于监视器检索增强生成（RAG）的自适应多智能体科学推理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）近期在科学推理方面取得了显著进展，但仍存在两大瓶颈。其一，显式检索会割裂推理过程，带来额外token和步骤所构成的隐性“工具税”。其二，多智能体流水线往往通过对所有候选方案取平均而稀释了优质解法。我们提出了一个融合隐式检索与结构化协作的统一框架来应对这些挑战。该框架的基础是一个基于监视器的检索模块，它在token级别运行，以对推理干扰最小的方式整合外部知识。在此基础之上，分层解法精炼（HSR）迭代地将每个候选解指定为锚点并由同伴智能体进行修复，而质量感知迭代推理（QAIR）则根据解的质量自适应地调整精炼过程。在Humanity's Last Exam（HLE）生物/化学黄金集上，我们的框架达到了48.3%的准确率——这是迄今为止报告的最高成绩，超越了……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出Eigen-Agent统一框架，以token级监视器检索模块实现最小干扰的隐式知识整合，并结合分层解法精炼（HSR）与质量感知迭代推理（QAIR）两项机制，在HLE生物/化学集上取得迄今最高的48.3%准确率。
en_tdlr: Eigen-Agent unifies token-level monitor-based implicit retrieval with Hierarchical Solution Refinement and Quality-Aware Iterative Reasoning, achieving a state-of-the-art 48.3% accuracy on HLE Bio/Chem.
